abstract: We study whether exogenous improvements in stock liquidity, unrelated to the information environment, affect managers’ disclosure choices. We exploit the 1997 Nasdaq reforms, which exogenously improved stock liquidity by reducing the non-information asymmetry components of the bid-ask spread, and find that Nasdaq firms reduced voluntary disclosure relative to a control group of unaffected firms. This evidence is consistent with managers substituting between components of the bid-ask spread when forming disclosure choices. Specifically, as the non-information asymmetry components decline, managers respond by decreasing disclosure, which in turn raises the information asymmetry component. Despite the reduction in disclosure and corresponding increase in information asymmetry, total stock liquidity nevertheless improves, suggesting that maintaining prior disclosure levels would have yielded minimal marginal benefits.
abstract_zh: 我们研究股票流动性的外生改善（与信息环境无关）是否会影响管理者的披露选择。我们利用1997年纳斯达克改革，该改革通过降低买卖价差中的非信息不对称成分，外生地提升了股票流动性，并发现相对于未受影响的对照组公司，纳斯达克公司在自愿披露方面有所减少。这一证据与管理者在形成披露选择时在买卖价差各成分之间进行替代的假设相一致。具体而言，随着非信息不对称成分的下降，管理者通过减少披露来应对，这反过来又提高了信息不对称成分。尽管披露减少且信息不对称相应增加，但总体股票流动性仍然改善，这表明维持原有披露水平所带来的边际收益可能微乎其微。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Exogenous stock liquidity improvements and voluntary disclosure
title_zh: 外生股票流动性改善与自愿性信息披露

abstract: In online markets, consumers tend to search and purchase prominently positioned products. We develop an experimental paradigm to distinguish between two mechanisms driving this behavior: position-specific search costs and beliefs about expected returns to search. Using incentivized experiments, we find that both mechanisms exist, and short-term randomization of rankings alone does not separate the two mechanisms. Failing to account for beliefs leads to biased estimates of search costs and incorrect consumer welfare predictions under alternative recommendation systems, such as platform self-preferencing. We discuss solutions for estimating unbiased search costs in real-world search settings. This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing. Funding: This work was supported by the UC Berkeley Fisher Center for Business Analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761 .
abstract_zh: 在网络市场中，消费者倾向于搜索并购买位于显著位置的商品。我们设计了一种实验范式，以区分驱动这一行为的两种机制：位置特定的搜索成本与对搜索预期回报的信念。通过激励性实验，我们发现这两种机制均存在，且仅靠排名的短期随机化无法将二者区分开来。若未能考虑信念因素，将导致对搜索成本的估计产生偏差，并在替代推荐系统（如平台自我偏好）下得出错误的消费者福利预测。我们探讨了在现实搜索环境中估计无偏搜索成本的解决方案。本文已被Raphael Thomadsen接受，市场营销领域。资助：本研究由加州大学伯克利分校费雪商业分析中心支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761 获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Consumer Inferences from Product Rankings: The Role of Beliefs in Search Behavior
title_zh: 消费者对产品排名的推断：信念在搜索行为中的作用

abstract: Firms led by older CEOs invest less, but the mechanism behind this age–investment gradient remains unclear. We study how CEO age shapes investment evaluation by eliciting CEOs' ratings of a project's investment attractiveness in a large-scale scenario-based experiment with more than 3700 CEOs from owner-managed Danish firms. Our design provides direct evidence on CEOs' investment evaluations by separating baseline differences in investment attractiveness from sensitivity to risk moments and payout horizon. Each CEO evaluates randomized capital-budgeting scenarios relative to the status quo, allowing us to distinguish a baseline shift in willingness to view projects as compelling from age differences in responsiveness to risk characteristics and payout horizon. We document a pronounced negative association between CEO age and investment attractiveness. Holding expected IRR, variance, skewness, and payout horizon constant, CEOs aged 60 or older rate the same opportunities as less attractive, while age differences in sensitivity to these attributes are weak. Standard stated risk attitudes and a lottery measure show no systematic age pattern. For external validity, we construct a CEO-specific inaction propensity from the experiment—the residual tendency to rate otherwise identical projects as less attractive after accounting for project characteristics—and show that it predicts lower investment in administrative data. Including this measure attenuates the reduced-form age–investment association, suggesting that age-related investment declines are not readily explained by conventional risk preferences or investment horizons alone, but also reflect a broader residual tendency towards lower investment propensity.
abstract_zh: 由年长CEO领导的企业投资较少，但这一年龄-投资梯度背后的机制尚不明确。我们通过一项涉及超过3700位丹麦所有者管理企业CEO的大规模情景实验，研究CEO年龄如何影响投资评估，实验中让CEO对项目的投资吸引力进行评分。我们的设计通过将投资吸引力的基线差异与对风险矩和支付期限的敏感性分离开来，提供了关于CEO投资评估的直接证据。每位CEO相对于现状评估随机化的资本预算情景，使我们能够区分将项目视为有吸引力的意愿的基线变化与年龄在风险特征和支付期限响应性上的差异。我们记录了CEO年龄与投资吸引力之间显著的负相关关系。在保持预期内部收益率、方差、偏度和支付期限不变的情况下，60岁及以上的CEO将相同机会评为吸引力较低，而年龄对这些属性敏感性的差异则较弱。标准陈述的风险态度和彩票测量未显示出系统性年龄模式。为验证外部有效性，我们从实验中构建了一个CEO特定的不作为倾向——在考虑项目特征后，对原本相同的项目评为吸引力较低的残余倾向——并显示它能预测行政数据中较低的投资水平。纳入这一测量削弱了简化形式的年龄-投资关联，表明与年龄相关的投资下降不能仅由传统风险偏好或投资期限轻易解释，还反映了一种更广泛的低投资倾向的残余趋势。
title: CEO aging and investment propensity: Experimental evidence
title_zh: CEO老龄化与投资倾向：实验证据

abstract: Existing contingent convertible bonds (CoCos) have several drawbacks for investors and issuers. This paper introduces the CCCR, a hybrid security that improves upon CoCos by adding an automatic share repurchase mechanism, requiring the company to repurchase shares if its financial condition worsens after the conversion of contingent debt securities into equity. We develop a structural model based on Leland’s framework to analyze a firm’s optimal capital structure, which includes equity, CCCR, and a straight debt. The model endogenously determines the CCCR’s features, and we derive pricing formulas for the firm’s liabilities. To ensure applicability, we derive a condition and corresponding minimum conversion ratio ensuring a one-to-one mapping between equity value and firm asset value. Our analysis of credit spreads, asset substitution, and other key financial metrics shows that, compared to alternative financing options, capital structures incorporating CCCR offer significant advantages for investors while imposing minimal additional costs on issuing firms, establishing this new security as a rational and viable form of contingent capital.
abstract_zh: 现有的或有可转换债券（CoCos）对投资者和发行方存在若干缺陷。本文介绍了一种混合证券——CCCR，它通过增加自动股份回购机制改进了CoCos，要求公司在或有债务证券转换为股权后，若财务状况恶化，则需回购股份。我们基于Leland框架构建了一个结构化模型，以分析企业的最优资本结构，该结构包括股权、CCCR和普通债务。模型内生地确定了CCCR的特征，并推导出企业负债的定价公式。为确保适用性，我们推导出一个条件及相应的最低转换比率，以保证股权价值与企业资产价值之间的一一对应关系。我们对信用利差、资产替代及其他关键财务指标的分析表明，与替代融资方案相比，包含CCCR的资本结构为投资者提供了显著优势，同时对发行企业施加的额外成本极小，从而确立了这一新证券作为合理且可行的或有资本形式。
title: Contingent capital with contingent share repurchase clause
title_zh: 附条件股份回购条款的应急资本

abstract: The objective of our study is to examine how migrant labour shifts due to the COVID‐19 pandemic influenced the adaptation behaviour of climate‐vulnerable farmers in Nepal. We examine how the resulting temporary change in climate change adaptation behaviour may be sustainable and improved after migrant labour returns to overseas employment by examining the relationship of institutional factors on climate change adaptation practices. A case study is presented using survey data collected from farmers in the Sunsari district of the eastern plains (Terai) region of Nepal during June 2022. Foreign‐employed migrants were found to have a positive relationship with the adoption of climate change adaptation practices. The finding implies that the presence of migrant household members (younger and more educated) is likely to encourage farmers to adopt more climate change adaptation practices. We further find that improving farmers' access to extension programmes, subsidies and the internet can be potentially used to sustain climate change adaptation practices in the post‐pandemic future. We demonstrate this by estimating the number of climate change adaptation practices by increasing farmers' access to extension programmes and subsidies under post‐pandemic labour scenarios. These estimates provide local policymakers tools to potentially improve accessibility to extension programmes or government subsidies that are likely to enhance farmers' climate change adaptation practices.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨COVID-19疫情导致的移民劳动力变化如何影响尼泊尔气候脆弱农户的适应行为。通过考察制度因素与气候变化适应实践之间的关系，我们分析了移民劳动力暂时性变化所导致的气候变化适应行为调整，在移民劳动力重返海外就业后是否具有可持续性并得以改善。本研究以2022年6月从尼泊尔东部平原（特莱）地区孙萨里县农户收集的调查数据为案例。研究发现，国外就业移民与气候变化适应实践的采纳呈正相关关系。这一发现表明，拥有海外务工家庭成员（较年轻且受教育程度较高）的农户更有可能采纳更多气候变化适应实践。进一步研究发现，改善农户获取推广项目、补贴和互联网的渠道，有望在疫情后时期维持气候变化适应实践。我们通过估算在疫情后劳动力情景下，增加农户获取推广项目和补贴渠道所带来的气候变化适应实践数量来验证这一结论。这些估算为地方政策制定者提供了工具，以改善推广项目或政府补贴的可及性，从而可能增强农户的气候变化适应实践。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title:
Do Shifts in Migrant Labour due to
                    COVID
                    ‐19 Affect Climate Change Adaptation Practices of Climate‐Vulnerable Farmers? Implications for the Post‐Pandemic Future
title_zh: 新冠疫情导致的移民劳工变动是否影响气候脆弱农户的气候变化适应实践？对后疫情时代的启示

abstract: Agricultural machinery operators constitute a crucial skilled workforce for mechanization service provision, but population ageing and rural labour outmigration are threatening the continuity of this workforce and the transmission of its operational skills. Using survey data from 2,458 agricultural machinery operators across five provinces in China, this study examines whether cooperative membership promotes apprenticeship-based skill transmission. The baseline results show that cooperative membership is significantly and positively associated with skill transmission. The results are robust to IV Poisson estimation, propensity score matching, and a negative binomial specification. Mechanism analysis suggests that cooperative membership may promote skill transmission by enhancing operators’ occupational identity and expanding their business volume. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that this positive association is stronger among multi-skilled operators and non-cross-regional operators. Additional analysis of operators who have not yet trained apprentices indicates that cooperative membership also increases their willingness and plans for future skill transmission. These findings suggest that cooperatives not only organize mechanization services and facilitate technology diffusion, but also serve as important platforms for agricultural human capital formation. KEYWORDS: Skill transmission apprenticeship training cooperative membership agricultural mechanization agricultural machinery operators JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J43 O15
abstract_zh: 农业机械操作人员是机械化服务供给的关键技能型劳动力，但人口老龄化和农村劳动力外流正威胁着这一劳动力队伍的延续及其操作技能的传承。利用中国五省2458名农业机械操作人员的调查数据，本研究考察了合作社成员身份是否促进基于学徒制的技能传承。基准结果表明，合作社成员身份与技能传承呈显著正相关。该结果在工具变量泊松估计、倾向得分匹配和负二项回归设定下均保持稳健。机制分析表明，合作社成员身份可能通过增强操作人员的职业认同感和扩大其业务规模来促进技能传承。异质性分析进一步显示，这一正向关联在多项技能操作人员和跨区域作业操作人员中更为显著。对尚未培养学徒的操作人员的补充分析表明，合作社成员身份也提高了他们未来进行技能传承的意愿和计划。这些研究发现表明，合作社不仅组织机械化服务并促进技术扩散，还充当农业人力资本形成的重要平台。关键词：技能传承 学徒培训 合作社成员身份 农业机械化 农业机械操作人员 JEL分类：J24 J43 O15

title: Cooperative membership and skill transmission: evidence from apprenticeship among agricultural machinery operators in China
title_zh: 合作社成员资格与技能传播：来自中国农业机械操作员学徒制的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the interplay between interoperability and the incentives to invest in cybersecurity in digital markets. We develop a two‐sided symmetric duopoly model in which cyberattacks create a congestion‐like externality, and interoperability amplifies hackers' incentives to target connected platforms. We show that interoperability affects cybersecurity investment through multiple channels, potentially producing a non‐monotonic relationship: Low interoperability promotes risk‐mitigation efforts, whereas high interoperability may discourage investment due to a public good effect. We then compare private and social incentives to adopt interoperability, identifying potential sources of misalignment. Finally, we extend the baseline model to account for additional factors shaping the desirability of interoperability, including platforms' business models, users' awareness of cyber risk, asymmetries in user bases, and the role of alternative compensation schemes.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了互操作性如何影响数字市场中网络安全投资的激励。我们构建了一个双边对称双寡头模型，其中网络攻击产生类似拥堵的外部性，而互操作性则增强了黑客针对互联平台的攻击动机。我们证明，互操作性通过多种渠道影响网络安全投资，可能产生非单调关系：低互操作性促进风险缓解努力，而高互操作性可能因公共物品效应抑制投资。随后，我们比较了采用互操作性的私人激励与社会激励，识别出潜在的错位来源。最后，我们将基线模型扩展，以纳入影响互操作性可取性的额外因素，包括平台商业模式、用户对网络风险的认知、用户基础的异质性以及替代补偿方案的作用。
title: Cyber(in)security and Interoperability in Digital Services
title_zh: 数字服务中的网络（不）安全与互操作性

abstract: This paper investigates how cash‐in‐advance (CIA) constraints on firm's production and innovation decisions affect the long‐run relationship between monetary policy and innovation‐based economic growth in an open economy. Firms produce differentiated goods and invest in process innovation to reduce production costs. With imperfect knowledge diffusion across countries, the country with the greater share of industry has relatively productive firms. When innovation has a stricter CIA requirement than production, higher nominal interest rates in the country with the larger (smaller) industrial share reduce (increase) productivity growth. We also examine how improved knowledge diffusion affects optimal nominal interest rate policy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在开放经济中，企业生产与创新决策面临的现金预付（CIA）约束如何影响货币政策与基于创新的经济增长之间的长期关系。企业生产差异化产品，并投资于流程创新以降低生产成本。由于知识跨国传播的不完全性，产业份额较大的国家拥有相对更具生产力的企业。当创新比生产面临更严格的现金预付要求时，产业份额较大（较小）的国家提高名义利率会降低（提升）生产率增长。我们还考察了知识传播改善如何影响最优名义利率政策。
title: International knowledge diffusion and productivity growth in a cash‐in‐advance economy
title_zh: 国际知识扩散与现金先行经济中的生产率增长

abstract: We examine the impact of formal adoption of inflation targeting (IT) on inflation, growth and anchoring of inflation expectations in advanced economies and emerging markets and developing economies. We find that while the early adopters of IT (pre‐2000) saw declines in inflation rates following adoption, IT adopters since then have enjoyed such success in only about half the cases. Our country‐level analysis—using the synthetic control method—shows that IT adoption delivers significant inflation gains in about a third of the cases. We find limited support for the concern that adoption of IT systematically leads to poorer growth outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了正式采用通货膨胀目标制（IT）对发达经济体及新兴市场和发展中经济体的通货膨胀、经济增长及通胀预期锚定的影响。研究发现，虽然早期（2000年前）采用IT的国家在采纳后经历了通胀率下降，但此后采用IT的国家仅在约半数案例中取得了此类成功。我们的国家层面分析——运用合成控制法——显示，IT采用在约三分之一的案例中带来了显著的通胀改善。对于IT采用系统性导致较差增长结果的担忧，我们发现了有限的支持证据。
title: Macroeconomic effects of formal adoption of inflation targeting
title_zh: 正式采用通货膨胀目标制的宏观经济效应

This paper examines whether China's gains in revealed comparative advantage (RCA) are associated with declining competitive positions among 24 incumbent economies and whether such changes coincide with structural regime transitions. abstract: Do impact investors seek impact, or merely “impact wash”? We provide systematic evidence on the nonfinancial determinants of impact investing. Impact investors focus on firms aligned with the priorities of the federal government and disproportionately invest in economically disadvantaged regions. While we find high levels of coinvestment between impact and traditional investors, we also show that impact investors influence the strategies of their traditional coinvestors, are more likely to fund firms in nascent industries, and invest countercyclically. Finally, we characterize investment heterogeneity based on a novel classification of impact investment theses, with a focus on climate, environment, and jobs and equity.
abstract_zh: 影响力投资者是在追求影响力，还是仅仅在“洗影响力”？我们提供了关于影响力投资非财务决定因素的系统性证据。影响力投资者聚焦于与联邦政府优先事项一致的企业，并不成比例地投资于经济欠发达地区。尽管我们发现影响力投资者与传统投资者之间存在高水平的联合投资，但我们也表明，影响力投资者会影响其传统联合投资者的策略，更倾向于资助新兴行业中的企业，并进行逆周期投资。最后，我们基于对影响力投资主题的新分类，重点关注气候、环境以及就业与公平，刻画了投资的异质性。
title: What Do Impact Investors Do Differently?*
title_zh: 影响力投资者有何不同？*

abstract: Multipurpose cadastre implementation is increasingly promoted as a key instrument for improving land administration, urban planning, taxation, service delivery, and land governance. However, local capacity to operationalise such systems remains uneven, particularly in peri-urban contexts where land pressure, institutional fragmentation, and weak cadastral documentation coexist. This study develops and tests a governance-readiness framework for assessing local capacity to support multipurpose cadastre implementation. Drawing on a purposive benchmarking sample of sixteen localities selected from a preliminary longlist of candidate cases across Africa, Europe, Asia, and North America, the study combines normalised governance indicators with partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). Governance readiness is modelled as a second-order formative construct, while Performance of Land Governance (PLG) is specified as a reflective outcome construct. The results show a strong positive relationship between governance readiness and PLG, with a standardised path coefficient of β = 0.849 and an explained variance of R² = 0.721. Robustness checks using Spearman rank correlation and ordinary least squares regression confirm the stability of this relationship, with ρ = 0.954 and OLS R² = 0.965. Agoè-Nyivé 2, located in the rapidly urbanising Greater Lomé metropolitan area in Togo, records particularly low readiness and PLG scores, highlighting the gap between cadastral needs and local governance capacity. The findings suggest that multipurpose cadastre implementation should be approached as a policy-readiness process requiring transparency, accountability, institutional coordination, technical capacity, and reliable land information systems.
abstract_zh: 多用途地籍的实施日益被推崇为改善土地管理、城市规划、税收、服务提供及土地治理的关键工具。然而，地方在运作此类系统方面的能力仍不均衡，尤其是在土地压力、制度碎片化及地籍文件薄弱并存的城郊地区。本研究开发并测试了一个治理就绪度框架，用以评估地方支持多用途地籍实施的能力。研究选取了来自非洲、欧洲、亚洲和北美洲的初步候选案例长名单中的十六个地方作为目的性基准样本，结合标准化治理指标与偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析。治理就绪度被建模为二阶形成性构念，而土地治理绩效（PLG）则被设定为反映性结果构念。结果显示，治理就绪度与PLG之间存在强正相关关系，标准化路径系数为β = 0.849，解释方差为R² = 0.721。采用斯皮尔曼秩相关和普通最小二乘回归进行的稳健性检验确认了该关系的稳定性，ρ = 0.954，OLS R² = 0.965。位于多哥大洛美都市区快速城市化地区的Agoè-Nyivé 2，其就绪度和PLG得分均特别低，凸显了地籍需求与地方治理能力之间的差距。研究结果表明，多用途地籍的实施应被视为一个政策就绪过程，需要透明度、问责制、机构协调、技术能力及可靠的土地信息系统。
title: From global benchmarking to local policy readiness: Assessing governance capacity for multipurpose cadastre implementation
title_zh: 从全球对标到地方政策准备：多用途地籍实施的治理能力评估

abstract: Energy performance disclosure is increasingly paired with minimum energy performance standards to accelerate the capitalization of energy inefficiency into housing prices and strengthen homeowners’ incentives to renovate inefficient dwellings. We study the 2021 French policy implementing a progressive rental ban on the least energy-efficient dwellings (“energy sieves”) and examine whether it has affected house prices. Using more than 900,000 housing transactions over 2014–2024, we document that energy sieves sell at an additional discount of about 5 percent following the policy announcement. Consistent with expected renovation costs driving the post-ban-announcement discount, the discount is much larger for houses that are costlier to renovate. The increase in the supply of G-rated houses on the sales market is also concentrated among those properties. While the post-ban-announcement discount reduces the gap between expected renovation costs to achieve compliance and expected sale loss due to non-compliance, we find limited evidence of a renovation response.
abstract_zh: 能源绩效披露正日益与最低能源绩效标准相结合，以加速能源低效在房价中的资本化，并增强业主翻新低效住宅的激励。我们研究了2021年法国实施的一项政策，该政策逐步禁止出租能效最低的住宅（“能源筛子”），并考察其是否影响了房价。利用2014年至2024年间超过90万笔住房交易数据，我们记录到，在政策宣布后，能源筛子类房产的售价出现了约5%的额外折价。与预期翻新成本驱动禁令宣布后折价这一现象一致，翻新成本较高的房屋折价幅度更大。销售市场上G级评级房屋供应的增加也主要集中在这些房产中。尽管禁令宣布后的折价缩小了实现合规所需的预期翻新成本与因不合规导致的预期销售损失之间的差距，但我们发现翻新反应的证据有限。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Minimum Energy Performance Standards and House Price Capitalization: Evidence from France’s Rental Ban on “Energy Sieves”
title_zh: 最低能源性能标准与房价资本化：来自法国“能源筛”租赁禁令的证据

abstract: Owner-occupied housing is exempt from property taxes in many countries. How does this exemption affect house prices, homeownership, and welfare? And if owner-occupied housing were taxed, should the tax be progressive? To address these questions, I develop a life-cycle model of homeownership with heterogeneous agents in which property taxation affects both the cost of owning and renting through the taxation of real-estate firms. I calibrate the model to match key features of a housing market with an owner-occupied exemption and a regressive effective property tax schedule. I study revenue-neutral reforms that remove the exemption and vary tax progressivity. Eliminating the exemption increases property tax revenues by over 1.2 percentage points of GDP but reduces homeownership substantially. However, moving to a flat or progressive property tax offsets part of this decline while still generating sizable revenue gains. These reforms improve long-run welfare for new generations, particularly for lower-income households, but reduce the welfare of households alive at the time of the reform, highlighting underlying political tensions.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，自有住房免征房产税。这一免税政策如何影响房价、住房拥有率及社会福利？若对自有住房征税，该税种是否应具有累进性？为解答这些问题，我构建了一个包含异质性代理人的生命周期住房拥有模型，其中房产税通过对房地产企业征税，同时影响购房与租赁成本。我将模型校准至与一个实行自有住房免税及累退性有效房产税税制的住房市场关键特征相匹配。我研究了取消免税并调整税收累进性的收入中性改革方案。取消免税将使房产税收入增加超过GDP的1.2个百分点，但会显著降低住房拥有率。然而，转向统一税率或累进性房产税可在部分抵消这一下降的同时，仍带来可观的收入增长。这些改革提升了新一代人的长期福利，尤其是对低收入家庭，但降低了改革时在世家庭的福利，凸显了潜在的政治张力。
title: Why Not Tax It? The effects of property taxes on house prices and homeownership
title_zh: 为何不征税？房产税对房价与住房自有率的影响

abstract: How do forest owners and managers – as policy addressees - intend to respond to EU policy – such as biodiversity and climate policy objectives - across different national contexts? Addressing this question, the study builds on social science behavioral theories to derive forest owner and manager types (FOTs) based on distinct decision-making logics. Using survey data from 1573 respondents in five European countries (Germany, Poland, Slovenia, Spain, and Sweden) and applying hierarchical cluster analysis, the study quantitatively identifies and validates these behavioral types across diverse institutional and ecological settings. The results show that multifunctionalists consistently support EU biodiversity and climate objectives, while optimizers tend to prioritize economic outcomes and often oppose regulatory interventions. Environmentalists display generally positive but context-dependent responses, whereas traditionalists show more limited support, particularly for stricter conservation measures. Across countries, the presence of similar behavioral types but varying response patterns highlights the importance of national context in shaping policy support and resistance. By linking behavioral typologies to EU policy objectives, the study advances forest policy and Europeanization research by introducing an actor-centered explanation of differentiated policy implementation outcomes. The findings provide insights for more targeted and context-sensitive policy design, while acknowledging the limits of survey-based measures of behavioral responses.
abstract_zh: 森林所有者和管理者作为政策对象，在不同国家背景下如何回应欧盟政策——例如生物多样性和气候政策目标？针对这一问题，本研究基于社会科学行为理论，依据不同的决策逻辑推导出森林所有者和管理者类型（FOTs）。利用来自五个欧洲国家（德国、波兰、斯洛文尼亚、西班牙和瑞典）1573名受访者的调查数据，并应用层次聚类分析，研究在多样化的制度和生态情境中定量识别并验证了这些行为类型。结果表明，多功能主义者始终支持欧盟的生物多样性和气候目标，而优化者倾向于优先考虑经济结果，并常常反对监管干预。环保主义者表现出总体积极但依情境而异的回应，而传统主义者则显示出较为有限的支持，尤其是在更严格的保护措施方面。跨国比较显示，相似行为类型的存在但回应模式各异，凸显了国家背景在塑造政策支持与抵制中的重要性。通过将行为类型学与欧盟政策目标相联系，本研究引入了一种以行动者为中心的解释，推进了森林政策和欧洲化研究，阐明了政策实施结果的差异性。研究结果为更具针对性和情境敏感性的政策设计提供了见解，同时也承认基于调查的行为回应测量存在局限性。
title: How policy addressees intend to respond to EU policy change? A cross-country survey analysis of forest owner behavioral types and responses to EU biodiversity and climate objectives
title_zh: 政策对象如何应对欧盟政策变化？森林所有者行为类型及其对欧盟生物多样性与气候目标响应的跨国调查分析

abstract: We study a mechanism-design-without-money setting in which a designer is interested in selecting items with maximum total value under a budget constraint. The items, however, are controlled by strategic agents who aim to maximize the total value of their selected items. This setting arises naturally when agencies select projects for funding, retailers choose products to stock, or hospitals schedule MRI scans. A mechanism governing the selection is strategyproof if no agent can benefit by hiding items they control from the mechanism. We are interested in mechanisms that are strategyproof and α-approximate, meaning that they always achieve at least an α-fraction of the optimal value for some α ∈ [0, 1]. First, we give a deterministic mechanism that is 1/ϕ 2-approximate, where 1/ϕ 2 ≈ 0.382 is the inverse of the square of the golden ratio. For the special case where all items have unit density, we design a deterministic 1/ϕ-approximate mechanism, where 1/ϕ ≈ 0.618. This result is tight as we show that no deterministic strategyproof mechanism with a better approximation exists. We further give randomized mechanisms with approximation guarantees of 1/2 for the general case and 2/3 for the unit-density case. For both the general and the unit-density settings, no randomized mechanism that is strategyproof in expectation can achieve an approximation guarantee better than 1 / ( 5 ϕ − 7 ) ≈ 0.917 .
abstract_zh: 我们研究一种无货币的机制设计场景，其中设计者旨在预算约束下选择总价值最大的项目。然而，这些项目由策略性代理人控制，他们旨在最大化其被选中项目的总价值。这一场景自然出现在机构选择资助项目、零售商决定库存商品或医院安排MRI扫描时。管理选择的机制是策略-proof的，如果没有任何代理人能通过向机制隐藏其控制的项目而获益。我们关注的是策略-proof且α-近似的机制，即对于某个α∈[0,1]，它们总能达到最优价值的至少α比例。首先，我们给出一个确定性机制，其近似比为1/φ²，其中1/φ²≈0.382是黄金比例平方的倒数。对于所有项目具有单位密度的特殊情况，我们设计了一个确定性1/φ近似机制，其中1/φ≈0.618。这一结果是紧致的，因为我们证明了不存在具有更好近似比的确定性策略-proof机制。我们进一步给出了随机机制，对于一般情况近似保证为1/2，对于单位密度情况为2/3。对于一般和单位密度设置，没有期望策略-proof的随机机制能实现优于1/(5φ−7)≈0.917的近似保证。
title: On the Strategyproof Allocation of Items Under a Budget Constraint
title_zh: 预算约束下物品的策略性配置研究

abstract: The student-optimal stable mechanism (DA), the most popular mechanism in school choice, is the only one that is stable and strategy-proof. However, when DA is implemented, a student can change the schools of others without changing her own. We show that this drawback is limited: a student cannot change her schoolmates while remaining at the same school. We refer to this new property as local non-bossiness and use it to provide a new characterization of DA that does not rely on stability. Furthermore, we show that local non-bossiness plays a crucial role in providing incentives to be truthful when students have preferences over their colleagues. As long as students have school-lexicographic preferences over colleagues—meaning that they first consider the school to which they are assigned and then their schoolmates—DA induces the only stable and strategy-proof mechanism. There is limited room to expand this preference domain without compromising the existence of a stable and strategy-proof mechanism.
abstract_zh: 学生最优稳定机制（DA）是学校选择中最常用的机制，也是唯一既稳定又防策略的机制。然而，在实施DA时，学生可以在不改变自身分配的情况下改变他人的学校分配。我们证明这一缺陷是有限的：学生无法在留在同一所学校的同时改变其同学。我们将这一新性质称为局部非专断性，并利用它提供了DA的一个不依赖稳定性的新特征刻画。此外，我们表明，当学生对同事有偏好时，局部非专断性在提供真实报告激励方面起着关键作用。只要学生对同事具有学校字典序偏好——即他们首先考虑被分配的学校，然后考虑同学——DA就能诱导出唯一稳定且防策略的机制。在不牺牲稳定且防策略机制存在性的前提下，扩展这一偏好域的空间十分有限。
title: local non-bossiness
title_zh: 局部非老板性

abstract: This paper asks how US tariffs on Chinese imports reshape trade across the nation's customs districts, and whether a district's earlier reliance on China shapes how deeply its imports fall. We build a monthly panel of HS6‐level US imports from eleven source countries arriving through eight customs districts between January 2017 and December 2025, and estimate product‐specific import‐demand elasticities by Poisson Pseudo‐Maximum Likelihood with three‐way high‐dimensional fixed effects. The estimated elasticity, which we interpret as a conditional import‐demand response among observed foreign suppliers rather than a fully structural Armington parameter, is substantially larger than earlier nationally aggregated studies have reported. This gap matters because it suggests that aggregation across entry points and product categories has long hidden how severe the trade destruction really is. Districts heavily dependent on Chinese imports before the tariff wave experience much sharper declines than less‐exposed ports. The pattern is sharpest for differentiated goods in which Chinese suppliers had already dominated before the tariff hit, where no obvious alternative source stands ready to absorb displaced demand. A further decomposition separates the contemporaneous response from anticipatory pre‐positioning and shows that a nontrivial share of what has been called the static elasticity actually reflects firms acting on expectations of future tariffs. Trade diversion flows mainly towards ASEAN economies, and distance plays essentially no role.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国对华进口关税如何重塑全国各海关地区的贸易格局，以及某一地区早期对中国的依赖程度是否影响其进口下降的深度。我们构建了一个月度面板数据集，涵盖2017年1月至2025年12月期间，来自11个来源国、经由8个海关地区进入美国的HS6级进口数据，并采用带有三维高维固定效应的泊松伪极大似然法估计产品层面的进口需求弹性。我们所估计的弹性，被解释为观测到的外国供应商之间的条件性进口需求反应，而非完全结构化的阿明顿参数，其数值显著大于此前全国性汇总研究的结果。这一差异至关重要，因为它表明，跨入境点和产品类别的汇总长期以来掩盖了贸易破坏的严重程度。在关税浪潮前高度依赖中国进口的地区，其进口下降幅度远大于暴露程度较低的港口。这一模式在差异化产品中最为显著，尤其是那些中国供应商在关税冲击前已占据主导地位的产品，这些产品缺乏明显的替代来源来吸收被转移的需求。进一步的分解将同期反应与预期性提前备货区分开来，并表明所谓的静态弹性中，有相当一部分实际上反映了企业基于对未来关税的预期而采取的行动。贸易转移主要流向东盟经济体，而距离因素几乎不起作用。

abstract: Urbanization, population growth and agricultural commodity demand increasingly shift land-use pressure toward distant rural frontiers, intensifying cropland expansion into tropical forests and creating substantial trade-offs between agricultural production and carbon-sink capacity. Yet where regional climate-policy land-demand pathways translate into forest-conversion risk, and how these risks overlap with agricultural-value and carbon-sink outcomes at fine spatial resolution, remains insufficiently quantified. We couple the Global Change Assessment Model (GCAM) with the Future Land Use Simulation (FLUS) model to assess cropland-expansion-driven deforestation in South America from 1992 to 2050, with the Amazon basin as the focal analytical region, under reference and 1.5 °C -consistent (1p5) pathways. We estimate agricultural value using a data-driven approach and quantify carbon impacts as changes in vegetation carbon-sink capacity. From 1992–2020, Amazon cropland increased by 2.12 × 105 km2 while forests declined by 3.51 × 105 km2, accounting for more than 60% of South America forest loss. Under the reference pathway, forest loss reaches 8.23 × 105 km2, including 1.10 × 105 km2 converted to cropland, causing an annual loss of 1.04 × 1010 kg of forest carbon sequestration while generating 4.79 × 108 GK$ in agricultural revenue. Under the 1p5 pathway, Amazon forest-to-cropland conversion declines to 7.00 × 103 km2, a 93.6% reduction relative to the reference pathway, and the net land-conversion effect shifts toward a carbon-sink gain. These results indicate an asymmetric agriculture-carbon trade-off, in which cropland expansion produces relatively limited agricultural-value gains while imposing large carbon-sink costs. The GCAM-FLUS framework identifies where such trade-offs are spatially concentrated and where mitigation-consistent land-demand pathways may reduce conversion risk. These policy implications should be interpreted together with local governance, tenure and supply-chain conditions, which are not directly simulated in the present modelling framework.
abstract_zh: 城市化、人口增长和农业商品需求日益将土地利用压力转向偏远的农村前沿地区，加剧了热带森林地区的耕地扩张，并在农业生产与碳汇能力之间产生了显著的权衡关系。然而，区域气候政策下的土地需求路径在何处转化为森林转换风险，以及这些风险如何在精细空间分辨率上与农业价值和碳汇结果重叠，仍未得到充分量化。我们将全球变化评估模型（GCAM）与未来土地利用模拟（FLUS）模型相结合，评估1992年至2050年间南美洲由耕地扩张驱动的森林砍伐，以亚马逊流域为焦点分析区域，并分别考虑参考路径和与1.5°C目标一致（1p5）的路径。我们采用数据驱动方法估算农业价值，并将碳影响量化为植被碳汇能力的变化。1992年至2020年间，亚马逊地区耕地增加了2.12×10⁵平方公里，而森林减少了3.51×10⁵平方公里，占南美洲森林损失的60%以上。在参考路径下，森林损失达到8.23×10⁵平方公里，其中1.10×10⁵平方公里转为耕地，导致森林碳汇年损失1.04×10¹⁰千克，同时产生4.79×10⁸ GK$的农业收入。在1p5路径下，亚马逊地区森林转耕地面积降至7.00×10³平方公里，较参考路径减少93.6%，净土地转换效应转向碳汇增益。这些结果表明存在不对称的农业-碳权衡关系，即耕地扩张带来的农业价值增益相对有限，却造成巨大的碳汇成本。GCAM-FLUS框架识别了此类权衡在空间上的集中区域，以及符合减缓目标的地需求路径可能在何处降低转换风险。这些政策启示应与地方治理、土地权属和供应链条件结合解读，而这些因素未在本建模框架中直接模拟。

title: Climate-policy pathways reshape cropland-expansion-driven deforestation and agricultural-carbon trade-off imbalance in the Amazon
title_zh: 气候政策路径重塑亚马逊地区农田扩张驱动的森林砍伐与农业碳权衡失衡

abstract: Increasing personal bankruptcy protection raises consumers’ desire to borrow and lenders’ cost of extending credit; the impact on equilibrium borrowing is ambiguous. Using bankruptcy protection changes between 1999 and 2005 across U.S. states, we find that borrowers respond to greater protection by increasing their unsecured debt. Border county estimates suggest that local economic conditions do not drive these results. Borrowers pay more for protection through higher interest rates, yet delinquency is unaffected. Our results indicate that rising borrower demand outstripped decreasing supply. Increased protections did not reduce the aggregate level of household debt but affected the composition of borrowing. (JEL G00, G33, G51, D14, D18, K35, R2)
abstract_zh: 提高个人破产保护会增加消费者的借贷意愿和贷款方的信贷成本；这对均衡借贷的影响是不确定的。利用1999年至2005年间美国各州破产保护的变化，我们发现借款人对更强的保护作出反应，增加了其无担保债务。边界县估计表明，当地经济状况并非这些结果的驱动因素。借款人通过更高的利率为保护支付更多，但违约率并未受到影响。我们的结果表明，上升的借款人需求超过了下降的供给。增强的保护并未减少家庭债务的总体水平，但影响了借贷的构成。（JEL G00, G33, G51, D14, D18, K35, R2）
title: Personal Bankruptcy Protection and Household Debt
title_zh: 个人破产保护与家庭债务

abstract: Superstitious beliefs, as culturally embedded cognitive biases, can influence managerial decision-making. This study examines the impact of CEOs’ zodiac-year superstition on corporate environmental investment. Using panel data on Chinese listed firms from 2008 to 2023, we find that CEOs become more risk-averse during their zodiac years, which leads firms to reduce environmental investment. This negative effect is weaker among younger or long-tenured CEOs and CEOs with academic or overseas backgrounds. It is also attenuated in state-owned firms, firms with low ownership concentration, and firms operating in polluting or capital-intensive industries. Specifically, the negative effect is concentrated in pollution control investments rather than pollution prevention investments. The findings highlight how culturally embedded managerial beliefs shape corporate environmental investment decisions by influencing CEOs’ risk preferences. KEYWORDS: Superstition CEOs zodiac year environmental strategy JEL CLASSIFICATION: M21 M12 Q56
abstract_zh: 迷信信念作为一种文化嵌入的认知偏差，能够影响管理者的决策。本研究考察了CEO本命年迷信对企业环境投资的影响。利用2008年至2023年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们发现CEO在本命年期间变得更加风险规避，从而导致企业减少环境投资。这一负面效应在年轻或任期较长的CEO以及具有学术或海外背景的CEO中较弱。此外，在国有企业、股权集中度较低的企业以及污染密集型或资本密集型行业中，该效应也有所减弱。具体而言，负面效应集中于污染治理投资而非污染预防投资。研究结果凸显了文化嵌入的管理者信念如何通过影响CEO的风险偏好来塑造企业环境投资决策。关键词：迷信；CEO；本命年；环境战略；JEL分类：M21 M12 Q56
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中国上市公司，数据为中国企业面板数据，制度背景涉及中国国企等，核心应用明确为中国情境。
title: Risk aversion or hedging? CEO superstition beliefs and corporate environmental investment
title_zh: 风险厌恶还是对冲？CEO迷信信念与企业环境投资

abstract: Climate change is having a devastating impact on artisanal fisheries communities in developing countries, including Nigeria. In Nigeria, multiple local conflicts have arisen as a result of climate‐related changes in coastal regions. This study investigates the impact of cooperatives and climate change adaptation on conflicts among artisanal fisherfolk in Nigeria. To capture climate change adaptation complexity, we employed the number of climate change adaptation strategies adopted as a count variable. We applied Endogenous Treatment Poisson Regression and Unconditional Quantile Regression models to analyze cross‐sectional data collected from artisanal fisherfolk in the coastal area of Nigeria. Findings from this research revealed that non‐fishing strategies are equally important as part of the climate change adaptation strategies with 43%, 22%, and 14% of the respondents adopting livelihood diversification, a community conflict resolution committee, and formation of local security outfits (vigilante), respectively. The results further showed that cooperatives play a significant role in increasing the number of climate change adaptation strategies adopted. Also, the study empirically established that cooperatives lessen the incidence, especially of the most severe conflicts among artisanal fisherfolk. Therefore, policy efforts should be geared towards strengthening and developing cooperative societies among artisanal fisherfolk in order to strengthen climate adaptation and reduce conflicts.
abstract_zh: 气候变化正对发展中国家（包括尼日利亚）的手工渔业社区造成毁灭性影响。在尼日利亚，气候变化引发的沿海地区变化已导致多起地方性冲突。本研究探讨了合作社与气候变化适应对手工渔民冲突的影响。为捕捉气候变化适应的复杂性，我们将所采用的气候变化适应策略数量作为计数变量。我们运用内生处理泊松回归和无条件分位数回归模型，分析了从尼日利亚沿海地区手工渔民收集的横截面数据。研究结果显示，非渔业策略在气候变化适应策略中同样重要，分别有43%、22%和14%的受访者采用了生计多样化、社区冲突解决委员会和组建地方安全组织（治安联防队）。结果进一步表明，合作社在增加所采用的气候变化适应策略数量方面发挥着重要作用。此外，研究实证确立了合作社能减少手工渔民之间冲突的发生率，尤其是最严重冲突的发生率。因此，政策努力应侧重于加强和发展手工渔民中的合作社组织，以增强气候适应能力并减少冲突。
title: Cooperatives and Climate Change Adaptation: A Pathway to Conflict Reduction in Artisanal Fisheries Communities in Nigeria
title_zh: 合作社与气候变化适应：尼日利亚手工渔业社区减少冲突的路径

abstract: : This study investigates convergent validity between elicitation formats within contingent valuation methodology, focusing on theory-driven formats designed to align with incentive compatibility. While earlier literature endorsed the single binary choice (SBC) format as the only incentive-compatible option, recent studies outline theoretical conditions under which payment card (PC) and open-ended (OE) formats may also encourage truthful preference revelation. We contribute to this debate by directly comparing these three theory-driven formats and assessing their robustness against bid-vector effects and other biases such as anchoring, yea-saying, and strategic misrepresentation. We conduct a large-scale, multi-country survey with 12,343 respondents across Poland, Sweden, Hungary, Spain, Germany, and the Netherlands, examining consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for an EU-wide biodiversity-enhancing program. The results indicate limited convergent validity across formats, with substantial discrepancies in WTP estimates. However, analysis of choice frequencies suggests that convergent validity holds for lower bid levels, whereas higher bids introduce differences. We argue that these differences stem from both behavioral biases and methodological factors, including bid vector design and econometric assumptions. Our results underscore the critical influence of bid structure on WTP estimates and highlight the need for further research to refine elicitation formats and econometric methods used in contingent valuation studies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了条件价值评估方法中不同诱导格式之间的收敛效度，重点关注旨在与激励相容性对齐的理论驱动型格式。尽管早期文献将单一二元选择（SBC）格式视为唯一具有激励相容性的选项，但近期研究提出了支付卡（PC）和开放式（OE）格式在特定理论条件下也可能促进真实偏好揭示的条件。我们通过直接比较这三种理论驱动型格式，并评估它们对投标向量效应及其他偏差（如锚定效应、附和倾向和策略性误报）的稳健性，为这一争论做出贡献。我们开展了一项大规模跨国调查，覆盖波兰、瑞典、匈牙利、西班牙、德国和荷兰的12,343名受访者，考察消费者对欧盟范围内生物多样性增强计划的支付意愿（WTP）。结果表明，各格式之间的收敛效度有限，WTP估计值存在显著差异。然而，选择频率分析显示，在较低投标水平下收敛效度成立，而较高投标水平则引入差异。我们认为，这些差异源于行为偏差和方法论因素，包括投标向量设计和计量经济学假设。我们的结果强调了投标结构对WTP估计的关键影响，并凸显了进一步研究以完善条件价值评估研究中诱导格式和计量经济学方法的必要性。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Convergent Validity in Incentive-Compatible Contingent Valuation: Bid-vector and elicitation format effects
title_zh: 激励相容条件价值评估中的收敛效度：投标向量与诱导格式效应

abstract: Deviations from covered interest rate parity (CIP) are often linked to limits to arbitrage, yet trading volumes surge during periods of apparent no-arbitrage violations. We show that these distortions stem from constraints on non-U.S. agents’ access to wholesale U.S. dollar markets and reflect a premium for unencumbered synthetic dollar funding: non-U.S. banks substitute secured USD borrowing with FX swaps to meet regulatory requirements. A shadow cost-augmented CIP condition holds, implying no riskless arbitrage. U.S. dealers extract rents on dollar provision while non-U.S. customers bear $10.4 billion in additional annual hedging costs. Our results illustrate how intermediary constraints segment global dollar funding.
abstract_zh: 抵补利率平价（CIP）的偏离常与套利限制相关联，然而在表面无套利机会的时期，交易量却激增。我们证明，这些扭曲源于非美国主体进入美国批发美元市场的限制，并反映了无负担合成美元融资的溢价：非美国银行以外汇互换替代有担保的美元借款，以满足监管要求。一个包含影子成本的增强型CIP条件成立，意味着不存在无风险套利。美国交易商在提供美元时获取租金，而非美国客户则承担每年104亿美元的额外对冲成本。我们的研究结果揭示了中介机构约束如何分割全球美元融资市场。
title: Segmented Dollar Funding
title_zh: 分段美元融资

abstract: This study examines the relationship between mergers and firm-level financial measures using a sample of 4,482 acquisition targets in the European Union from 2007 to 2021. Findings suggest that horizontal mergers lack statistically significant results, whereas vertical mergers entail changes in markups (-0.7%), market share (+2.5%), Return on Fixed Assets (ROFA) (+2.3%), and capital intensity (-7.2%). The result for vertical mergers increases over time, and is larger when the number of pre-existing subsidiaries is greater. Our results suggest the elimination of double profit margins as a potential explanation.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2007年至2021年间欧盟4,482个收购目标样本，探讨了并购与企业层面财务指标之间的关系。研究发现，横向并购在统计上不显著，而纵向并购则涉及加成率（-0.7%）、市场份额（+2.5%）、固定资产回报率（ROFA）（+2.3%）和资本密集度（-7.2%）的变化。纵向并购的效果随时间增强，且在既有子公司数量较多时更为显著。我们的结果提示，消除双重利润边际可能是一个潜在的解释机制。
title: Procompetitive effects of vertical mergers? Evidence from the European Union
title_zh: 纵向合并的促进竞争效应？来自欧盟的证据

abstract: Does past treatment for depression create resilience to future shocks? We study a randomized CBT-based intervention for prenatally depressed mothers in Pakistan and exploit variation in COVID-19 restriction stringency six years after childbirth. Treated women were protected against restriction-induced anxiety, depression, comorbidity, and functional impairment. Protection extended to spousal relationships, offsetting restriction-driven declines in relationship quality and increases in marital conflict. This resilience operates through psychological channels: the intervention builds locus of control and self-efficacy, strengthens family and partner support, and reduces how overwhelmed women feel when shocks arrive. The resulting psychological capital has returns well beyond the treated condition.
abstract_zh: 过去的抑郁症治疗是否能为未来冲击建立韧性？我们研究了一项基于认知行为疗法的随机干预，对象为巴基斯坦产前抑郁母亲，并利用分娩六年后新冠疫情限制严格程度的变异。接受治疗的女性在面对限制引发的焦虑、抑郁、共病及功能损害时得到了保护。这种保护还延伸至配偶关系，抵消了因限制导致的亲密关系质量下降和婚姻冲突增加。这种韧性通过心理渠道发挥作用：干预增强了控制点和自我效能感，强化了家庭和伴侣支持，并减少了女性在冲击到来时的无助感。由此产生的心理资本回报远超所治疗的具体病症本身。
title: Building resilience through psychological intervention
title_zh: 通过心理干预构建韧性

abstract: The voluntary carbon market was built on a single promise: that one credit cancels one tonne. Most scrutiny has asked whether that promise holds on the supply side – whether the credits are real. This column asks a different question: what did the mere availability of offsets do to the firms that bought them? Using a buyer-linked dataset spanning the near-universe of offset retirements, and the 2023 integrity scandals as a natural experiment, the authors find that firms which walked away from offsetting cut their own operational emissions sharply more than firms that stayed. Even a market of flawless credits could still slow real decarbonisation.
abstract_zh: 自愿性碳市场建立在一个单一承诺之上：一单位碳信用抵消一吨排放。多数审查关注的是这一承诺在供应端是否成立——即碳信用是否真实。本文提出一个不同的问题：仅仅是抵消机制的可获得性，对购买这些碳信用的企业产生了何种影响？利用覆盖近乎全部碳信用注销的买方关联数据集，并以2023年诚信丑闻作为自然实验，作者发现，放弃抵消的企业其自身运营排放的削减幅度显著大于继续参与抵消的企业。即便碳信用市场完美无瑕，仍可能延缓实际的脱碳进程。
authors: Ugo Panizza, Francesco Tripoli, Beatrice Weder di Mauro
title: An autopsy of the voluntary carbon market
title_zh: 自愿碳市场剖析

abstract: Climate change is increasingly affecting buildings, infrastructure, natural systems, and socio-economic activities in urban areas, while cities also contribute significantly to global warming through high energy consumption and carbon emissions from buildings, transport, waste, and energy systems. In this context, urban design plays a crucial role in advancing climate-resilient and low-carbon development. However, existing assessment systems still tend to address climate change adaptation and mitigation separately, limiting the holistic evaluation of urban design scenarios. This study develops a methodological framework for the integrated assessment of climate change adaptation and mitigation in urban design. The framework is based on a structured set of key performance indicators and associated design measures to support the evaluation of built environment vulnerabilities, carbon emission drivers, and the performance of urban design scenarios across multiple scales and climate hazards in both urban regeneration and new development projects. The results show that current environmental assessment systems predominantly prioritize either mitigation or adaptation, without adequately capturing their interrelations within the built environment. The proposed framework addresses this gap by supporting scenario comparison and design decision-making through an integrated, multiscale approach. The findings also highlight the strategic role of green and blue measures for buildings and open spaces, as these solutions can simultaneously enhance climate adaptation and mitigation. Overall, the framework provides a coherent basis for more integrated climate-responsive urban design assessment.
abstract_zh: 气候变化日益影响城市地区的建筑、基础设施、自然系统和社会经济活动，同时，城市通过建筑、交通、废弃物和能源系统的高能耗与高碳排放，也对全球变暖产生显著贡献。在此背景下，城市设计在推进气候韧性和低碳发展方面发挥着关键作用。然而，现有评估体系仍倾向于将气候变化适应与减缓分开处理，限制了对城市设计方案的整体性评价。本研究构建了一个用于城市设计中气候变化适应与减缓综合评估的方法框架。该框架基于一套结构化的关键绩效指标及相关设计措施，以支持对建成环境脆弱性、碳排放驱动因素以及城市设计方案在多尺度和多种气候灾害下的表现进行评估，适用于城市更新和新建项目。结果表明，当前环境评估体系主要优先考虑减缓或适应中的某一方，未能充分捕捉建成环境中两者之间的相互关系。所提出的框架通过支持情景比较和设计决策，以综合、多尺度的方式弥补了这一不足。研究结果还强调了绿色和蓝色措施在建筑及开放空间中的战略作用，因为这些解决方案能够同时增强气候适应与减缓能力。总体而言，该框架为更综合的气候响应型城市设计评估提供了连贯的基础。
title: A methodological framework for integrated climate adaptation and mitigation assessment in urban design
title_zh: 城市设计中气候适应与减缓综合评估的方法论框架

abstract: This paper examines how pandemic-induced layoffs contributed to post-Covid-19 inflation through their effects on retirement and labor supply. Using CPS microdata, we show that the unprecedented “Great Layoff” triggered a sharp rise in early retirements— the “Great Retirement”—which increased labor market tightness and nominal wages. Younger non-participants were drawn into employment, partly offsetting the loss of older workers. To quantify this mechanism, we estimate a New Keynesian model with endogenous participation and retirement. Counterfactual simulations show that the Great Retirement accounted for roughly three cumulative percentage points of inflation from 2020 to 2024, with modest GDP effects.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了疫情引发的裁员如何通过影响退休与劳动力供给，进而对新冠疫情后的通货膨胀产生作用。利用CPS微观数据，我们揭示出前所未有的“大裁员”触发了早期退休潮——“大退休”——这加剧了劳动力市场的紧张状况并推高了名义工资。年轻非参与者被吸引进入就业市场，部分抵消了老年劳动力的流失。为量化这一机制，我们估算了一个包含内生参与和退休决策的新凯恩斯模型。反事实模拟显示，“大退休”在2020年至2024年间大约贡献了三个累计百分点的通货膨胀，而对GDP的影响则较为温和。
title: Great Layoff, Great Retirement and Post-pandemic Inflation
title_zh: 大规模裁员、大退休与疫情后通胀

abstract: Why are certain movies more successful in some markets than others? Are the entertainment products we consume reflective of our core beliefs? To answer these questions, we analyze international movie data and local tales using machine learning to measure a plot’s similarity to traditional motifs. Globally, films mirroring local folklore get wider screenings and earn more. Across US markets, movies matching ancestral stories attract more interest. Finally, films endorsing risk-taking, vengeance-seeking, and traditional gender roles outperform across markets holding similar historical and contemporary norms. Choosing to watch modern adaptations of stories passed down from our ancestors on the big screen reinforces cultural identity.
abstract_zh: 为何某些电影在特定市场更为成功？我们所消费的娱乐产品是否映射了我们的核心价值观？为解答这些问题，我们运用机器学习分析国际电影数据与地方传说，衡量剧情与传统母题的相似度。全球范围内，反映当地民间故事的电影获得更广泛的放映并取得更高票房。在美国各市场，与祖先故事相契合的电影更能吸引观众兴趣。最后，那些推崇冒险精神、复仇心理及传统性别角色的电影，在拥有相似历史与当代规范的市场中表现更佳。选择在大银幕上观看祖先流传下来的故事的现代改编，强化了文化认同。
title: Myths, Morals, and Movies
title_zh: 神话、道德与电影

abstract: This paper synthesizes the literature on vulnerabilities in government bond-backed repo markets, focusing on the features that contribute to both the fragility and stability of these markets. The literature shows that the same features that enable efficient liquidity provision, including short-term funding, dealer intermediation, extensive collateral reuse, and low haircuts, can also create channels for rapid transmission of stress. The review documents tight linkages between repo and government bond markets, highlighting how repos are key to the build-up of leverage and can propagate stress across funding, cash, and derivatives markets, particularly through dealers and nonbank financial intermediaries such as investment firms, hedge funds, and money market funds. Evidence from recent stress episodes illustrates how these vulnerabilities materialize in practice. The review also examines post-crisis regulatory reforms and central bank interventions, identifying how these measures have enhanced market resilience while also creating trade-offs for market dynamics, with implications for liquidity and collateral availability.
abstract_zh: 本文综合梳理了以政府债券为抵押品的回购市场中脆弱性的相关文献，重点关注促成这些市场既脆弱又稳定的特征。文献表明，那些能够实现高效流动性提供的相同特征，包括短期融资、交易商中介、广泛的抵押品再使用以及低折扣率，也可能成为压力快速传导的渠道。本综述记录了回购市场与政府债券市场之间的紧密联系，强调回购在杠杆积累中的关键作用，并可通过交易商及非银行金融中介机构（如投资公司、对冲基金和货币市场基金）将压力传导至融资、现金和衍生品市场。近期压力事件的证据展示了这些脆弱性在实践中如何显现。本综述还考察了危机后的监管改革和中央银行干预措施，识别了这些措施如何增强市场韧性，同时为市场动态带来权衡取舍，对流动性和抵押品可得性产生影响。
title: Government bond-backed repo markets: between resilience and vulnerability
title_zh: 政府债券回购市场：韧性与脆弱性之间
